decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are a low-cost, limited-run niche offering for collectors that ties up little capital, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations the small retailer has no trigger for problemistic search and will likely keep it in the range.

A German new wave (Neue Deutsche Welle) compilation series fits steady collector demand in the German vinyl market, and after only one year with outcomes still uncertain, management will judge it meets aspirations and keep it.
